verdict.rationale: Gemini's first-party docs describe a dedicated Deep Research feature for in-depth, real-time research on almost any subject. It uses Google Search by default and can add sources such as Gmail, Drive, uploaded files and NotebookLM notebooks, which delivers the core of a launchable deep research run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the output is a cited report, detail on how the run autonomously searches many sources, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Deep Research quality.
